The issuer shows solid operating profitability (EBIT of 3,639M on revenue of 12,222M) and positive retained earnings, supporting ongoing business resilience. However, leverage is high (total liabilities of 78,289M vs. total assets of 96,889M), and liquidity is only moderate (current ratio 1.27), which limits balance-sheet flexibility during downturns. Overall, credit quality appears in the lower investment-grade range.  
DECISION: BBB-
